third_party.note: category and description are that author's reverse-engineering notes, re-checked here only for the name; they are unverified and every printed description must say so

VBDllUnRegisterServer.description: Unregisters VB project classes; retn varies

VBDllGetClassObject.description: User-project class factory creation; compares IIDs; creates basic_class object; retn 0x18

UserDllMain.description: VB6 user DLL entry; handles DLL_PROCESS_ATTACH(1); DLL_PROCESS_DETACH(0); DLL_THREAD_ATTACH(2); retn 0x14

DllRegisterServer.description: Gets module filename; loads type library; registers; bare retn

__vbaAryLock.description: Calls SafeArrayLock(psa); stores psa into *ppLocked; returns psa. Raises error 9 if psa is NULL. retn 0x8.

__vbaRedimVar2.description: 0x660eda90; UDT-aware version with extra pUdtInfo param; delegates to 0x660ed604 with preserve=0

__vbaStrErrVarCopy.description: Thin wrapper around rtBstrFromErrVar; extracts error BSTR from Variant

__vbaVarLateMemSt.description: object as VARIANT; store via flag=4

__vbaAryVarVarg.description: Wraps a varg array into a VARIANT. Sets pDst->vt=VT_ARRAY|VT_VARIANT (0x200c); calls internal to build SAFEARRAY from stack args. bare retn.

__vbaFpCDblR4.description: 0x661120d2; validates FPU st0 fits in double precision (store/reload via qword)

__vbaFpCDblR8.description: export at ordinal 20; round-trip through qword to validate

__vbaFpCSngR4.description: 0x661120bb; validates FPU st0 fits in single precision (store/reload via dword)

__vbaFpCSngR8.description: export at ordinal 22; likely same validation path as FpCDblR4

__vbaFpCmpCy.description: 0x661120e9; retn 0x8; compares FPU st0 against CY value on stack; returns -1/0/1

__vbaFpCy.description: 0x6611206a; converts FPU st0 to scaled CY (multiply by 10000); returns EDX:EAX

__vbaFpI2.description: pops ST(0)→int16; frndint+fist; overflow check via fnstsw

__vbaFpI4.description: pops ST(0)→int32; frndint+fist; overflow check via fnstsw

__vbaFpUI1.description: 0x66112045; rounds FPU st0 to integer; validates 0..255 range; returns in EAX

__vbaFreeVarg.description: Frees a VARIANT arg; dispatches by vt: SysFreeString for BSTR; Release for objects; SafeArrayDestroy for arrays; else __vbaFreeVar

__vbaI2I4.description: ecx=val; int32→int16 with overflow check; raises error 6

__vbaI4Abs.description: ecx=val; absolute value; raises error 6 if INT_MIN

__vbaUI1I2.description: ecx=val; int16→uint8 with overflow check; raises error 6

__vbaUI1I4.description: Range checks value<=0xFF; overflow -> error 6; bare retn

__vbaUI1Sgn.description: Branchless: returns 0 or 1 (unsigned byte can't be negative); bare retn

__vbaVarCopy.description: ecx=dst edx=src; deep copy (BSTR dup/IUnknown AddRef/ByRef deref)

__vbaVarDup.description: ecx=dst edx=src; fast memcpy 16 bytes for simple types

__vbaVarMove.description: ecx=dst edx=src; frees dst then moves src; zeroes src vt

__vbaVarVargNofree.description: ecx=dst edx=src; resolves VT_VARIANT|VT_BYREF; no free on dst

__vbaVargParmRef.description: Dereferences VT_BYREF|VT_VARIANT; if flag set returns pVar->pvarVal; else returns pVar

__vbaVargVar.description: Copies 16-byte VARIANT from ecx to pDstVar; if not VT_BYREF; sets VT_BYREF|VT_VARIANT pointing to src

__vbaVargVarCopy.description: Copies VARIANT via internal helper with flag=0 (deep copy); returns pSrcVar in eax

__vbaVargVarMove.description: Moves VARIANT via internal helper with flag=1 (move/steal); returns pSrcVar

__vbaVargVarRef.description: Copies 16 bytes from pSrcVar to pDstVar; if not VT_BYREF; makes it VT_BYREF|VT_VARIANT

DLLGetDocumentation.description: Loads string resource; converts to BSTR; retn 0x14

DllCanUnloadNow.description: Checks global refcount at 0x66119c78; returns S_FALSE(1) if nonzero; S_OK(0) if zero; bare retn

DllGetClassObject.description: Compares rclsid to internal CLSID; creates class factory; retn 0xc

_CIatan.description: FPU intrinsic: pops st(0) to stack; calls atan helper; pushes result back to FPU

_CIcos.description: FPU intrinsic: pops st(0) to stack; calls cos helper; pushes result back to FPU

_CIlog.description: FPU intrinsic: pops st(0) to stack; calls log helper; pushes result back to FPU

_CIsin.description: FPU intrinsic: pops st(0) to stack; calls sin helper; pushes result back to FPU

_CIsqrt.description: FPU intrinsic: pops st(0) to stack; calls sqrt helper; pushes result back to FPU

__vbaAptOffset.description: Returns apartment thread offset; returns 0 if single-threaded; reads TLS for multi-apartment

__vbaAryConstruct2.description: Like AryConstruct but with explicit bounds pointer (3rd param). If descriptor has FADF_AUTO (0x20) bit; dereferences pBounds. retn 0xc.

__vbaAryConstruct.description: Thin wrapper: calls sub_660482ba(ppAry; pDescriptor; 0) then error handler. Creates array from descriptor with no extra bounds. retn 0x8.

__vbaAryCopy.description: Erases dst if different from src; then copies src array to dst via SafeArrayCopy. retn 0x8.

__vbaAryMove.description: erases dst; moves src ptr to dst; NULLs src

__vbaAryRebase1Var.description: If pVar holds VT_ARRAY|VT_VARIANT (0x200c) with a 1-dim SAFEARRAY; sets lLbound=1 (Option Base 1). retn 0x4.

__vbaAryRecCopy.description: Copies a record (UDT) array. Uses pRecInfo for element-level copy semantics. Erases dst first if needed. retn 0xc.

__vbaAryRecMove.description: Moves a record (UDT) array. Erases dst; then moves src pointer to dst and zeroes src. retn 0xc.

__vbaAryVar.description: Extracts SAFEARRAY* from a VARIANT. Validates VT_ARRAY bit (0x2000); handles VT_BYREF indirection. Validates element type matches vt. retn 0x8.

__vbaCVarAryUdt.description: Converts a UDT array to a VARIANT. Creates SAFEARRAY descriptor if needed; sets element size/type; copies IRecordInfo. Stores result in pDst. retn 0x10.

__vbaCastObjVar.description: extracts obj from VT_DISPATCH/VT_UNKNOWN variant then QI

__vbaCheckType.description: QI to piid; succeeds→Release and return -1; fails→return 0

__vbaCheckTypeVar.description: Extracts IDispatch; QueryInterface with GUID; returns -1 match / 0 no match; retn 8

__vbaChkstk.description: custom CC: EAX=alloc size; probes pages in 0x1000 increments

__vbaCopyBytes.description: memcpy-like: copies cbSize bytes from pSrc to pDst; returns pDst

__vbaCopyBytesZero.description: Copies cbSize bytes from pSrc to pDst; then zeros pSrc; returns pDst

__vbaCyAbs.description: If high dword negative; neg low + not/sbb high; overflow check; retn 8

ProcCallEngine.description: Custom CC: edx=RTMI ptr; return addr on stack; sets up P-Code frame; dispatches opcodes via jump table at 0x6610aa24

DllFunctionCall.description: resolves Declare imports; returns function pointer

__vbaCyAdd.description: 64-bit add via add/adc; overflow→error 6; returns EDX:EAX

__vbaCyErrVar.description: Like CyVar but with Error variant support; thunk -> shared dispatcher

__vbaCyForInit.description: Stores start into *pCounter; then calls ForNext check; retn 0x1C

__vbaCyForNext.description: Adds step via __vbaCyAdd; stores; then checks limit; retn 0x14

__vbaCyI2.description: movsx; imul * 10000; returns in EDX:EAX; retn 4

TipGetAddressOfPredeclaredInstance.description: Returns ptr to ObjectData+0x8 for predeclared instance; retn 0xc

__vbaCyI4.description: imul value * 10000; returns in EDX:EAX; retn 4

MethCallEngine.description: Custom CC: sub [esp+4];eax adjusts 'this' offset; tail-jumps to ProcCallEngine_Body

__vbaCySgn.description: Pushes 0:0 and cyValue; calls internal CY compare; retn 8

__vbaCyStr.description: Calls VarCyFromStr; returns CY in EDX:EAX; retn 4

__vbaCySub.description: 64-bit sub via sub/sbb; overflow→error 6; returns EDX:EAX

__vbaCyUI1.description: movzx byte; imul 10000; returns in EDX:EAX; retn 4

__vbaCyVar.description: Dispatches via vtype jump table; returns CY in EDX:EAX; thunk -> shared dispatcher

__vbaDateR4.description: Widens float->double; range checks VB date bounds; retn 4

__vbaDateR8.description: range-checks double against DATE bounds; returns on ST(0)

__vbaDateStr.description: Calls VarDateFromStr (fallback VarR8FromStr + range check); retn 4

__vbaDateVar.description: variant→date; calls __vbaVarDateVar then loads qword to ST(0)

__vbaDerefAry.description: Multi-dimensional array element dereference. Variadic indices follow on stack. Validates dims/bounds; computes pvData + element offset. bare retn (cdecl; caller cleans).

__vbaDerefAry1.description: 1-dimensional array element dereference. Validates dims==1 and bounds; returns pvData + cbElements*(index-lLbound). retn 0x8.

__vbaEraseKeepData.description: Erases array data but keeps the descriptor. Sets FADF_FIXEDSIZE|FADF_STATIC (0x12) before erase; clears after. retn 0x8.

__vbaEraseNoPop.description: Validates array not locked (fFeatures & 0x16 == 0); then calls __vbaErase(0; ppAry). retn 0x4.

__vbaError.description: 0x660e6a99; retn 0x4; raises VB error by number; 0 or >0xFFFF maps to error 5 (invalid call)

__vbaErrorOverflow.description: 0x660e6ab2; pushes 6 (Overflow) and calls error handler; noreturn

__vbaExceptHandler.description: standard SEH handler; handles stack overflow specially

__vbaExitEachAry.description: 0x6611197d; retn 0x4; calls SafeArrayUnlock and clears pointer

__vbaExitEachColl.description: 0x6611199f; retn 0x4; Release()s the enumerator and clears pointer

__vbaExitEachVar.description: 0x6611195d; retn 0xc; dispatches to __vbaExitEachAry or __vbaExitEachColl based on ppsa

__vbaExitProc.description: walks SEH chain via fs:[0]; clears TLS error state

__vbaFPException.description: export at ordinal 124; 0x660f5daa is FPInt; FPException likely shares overflow check path at 0x66112026

__vbaFPFix.description: export at ordinal 125; FPU st0 truncation toward zero (uses fldcw to set rounding mode)

__vbaFPInt.description: 0x660f5daa; operates on FPU st0; fwait; set truncation rounding mode; frndint; restore rounding mode

TipUnloadProject.description: Checks project on stack; enters critsec; cleans up object table; releases ExecProj; retn 0x4

__vbaFailedFriend.description: 0x660e592d; pushes error 0x61 (97 = Friend access violation) and calls error handler; noreturn

__vbaFileClose.description: if 0=no-op; otherwise delegates to internal close

EbGetHandleOfExecutingProject.description: Reads TLS -> execution context -> project handle; retn 0x4

__vbaFileCloseAll.description: 0x660f3c8e; retn 0x4; shares implementation with __vbaFileLock/FileClose path; fileNum=0 closes all

__vbaFileSeek.description: 0x660f33b0; retn 0x8; validates file/record num; sets seek position in file channel structure

__vbaFixstrConstruct.description: Allocates zero-filled fixed-length BSTR; stores in *ppBstr; error 0xe on OOM

__vbaForEachAry.description: 0x6610c6a8; retn 0xc; calls __vbaForEachCollVar internally; extracts IDispatch from VARIANT

__vbaForEachCollObj.description: calls ForEachCollAd; QI for target interface

__vbaGenerateBoundsError.description: 0x660edaf4; pushes error 9 (Subscript out of range) and calls error handler; noreturn

__vbaGet4.description: 0x660f34fd; retn 0x10; file Get# with 4 params (includes length)

__vbaGetFxStr3.description: 0x66056863; retn 0xc; Get# for fixed-length string; 3 params

__vbaGetFxStr4.description: 0x660f358d; retn 0x10; Get# for fixed-length string; 4 params

__vbaGetOwner3.description: 0x660567f5; retn 0xc; Get# with owner object; 3 params

__vbaGetOwner4.description: 0x660f3538; retn 0x10; Get# with owner object; 4 params

__vbaGosub.description: Pushes gosub entry: allocates 8-byte node (next; retaddr); links to stack head; returns 0 (success); raises error 7 (OOM) on failure

__vbaGosubFree.description: Frees entire gosub stack linked list; walks list freeing each node

__vbaGosubReturn.description: Pops gosub stack: restores return address from linked list node; frees node; returns 1 on success; raises error 3 if stack empty

__vbaHresultCheck.description: 0x660427c2; retn 0x10; checks TLS error state; converts specific HRESULTs (0x800A9C68->0x800A01B8); dispatches to error mapper

__vbaHresultCheckNonvirt.description: export exists; similar to HresultCheck but for non-virtual calls

__vbaHresultCheckObj.description: checks HRESULT; raises error if failed

__vbaI2ErrVar.description: Dispatches via vtype jump table; entry thunk loads ECX=vtable; jmps to shared dispatcher

__vbaI2ForNextCheck.description: export exists at ordinal 35; integer For/Next boundary check for Int16

TipUnloadInstance.description: Unloads VB object instance; retn varies

EbLibraryLoad.description: Stores callback ptr to global 0x66119380; retn 0x4

__vbaI4ForNextCheck.description: export exists at ordinal 172; integer For/Next boundary check for Int32

EbLoadRunTime.description: Massive function: loads ObjectTable; sets up ExecProj; iterates objects; resolves vtables; ebp-based; retn 0x8

__vbaI4Var.description: variant→int32; shared dispatch body with I2Var

EbCreateContext.description: Allocates 0x1c-byte context; zeroes it; returns ptr via *ppContext; retn 0x4

__vbaInputFile.description: 0x660eace1; var-args; reads typed values from file per type descriptor array

__vbaLateIdCallLd.description: like LateIdCall but captures return value

__vbaLateIdCallSt.description: 0x6610c2f3; wraps __vbaLateIdCall with DISPATCH_METHOD flag; pushes 0 result then delegates to common late-bind dispatcher at 0x66106631

__vbaLateIdStAd.description: 0x6610c29d; late-bound property store by DispID with address result; flag 0x8 (DISPATCH_PROPERTYPUTREF)

__vbaLateMemCallLd.description: like LateMemCall but captures return value

EbIsProjectOnStack.description: Checks TLS for project presence on call stack; retn 0x4

TipCreateInstanceEx.description: Extended CoCreateInstance wrapper for VB projects; retn varies

GetMem2.description: Reads 2 bytes (word) from *src into *dst; returns 0; retn 0x8

GetMem4.description: Reads 4 bytes (dword) from *src into *dst; returns 0; retn 0x8

GetMem8.description: Reads 8 bytes (qword) from *src into *dst; returns 0; retn 0x8

GetMemStr.description: Copies BSTR via SysAllocStringByteLen; returns 0 or 0x8007000e (E_OUTOFMEMORY); retn 0x8

GetMemVar.description: Copies VARIANT via VariantCopy; returns 0; retn 0x8

GetMemObj.description: Copies IUnknown* and calls AddRef; returns 0; retn 0x8

PutMem2.description: Writes low word of val to *dst; returns 0; retn 0x8

PutMem4.description: Writes dword val to *dst; returns 0; retn 0x8

PutMem8.description: Writes qword lo:hi to *dst; returns 0; retn 0xc

PutMemStr.description: Allocates new BSTR copy; frees old; stores new; retn 0x8

PutMemVar.description: Copies VARIANT via VariantCopyInd; handles VT_DISPATCH extraction; ebp-based; retn 0x8

PutMemObj.description: Complex: extracts IDispatch from Variant; calls Invoke to assign; ebp-based; retn 0x8

SetMemVar.description: Validates VT_DISPATCH/VT_UNKNOWN; swaps object references; ebp-based; retn 0x8

SetMemObj.description: AddRef new obj; swap into *dst; Release old; retn 0x8

GetMemNewObj.description: Auto-creates object if slot empty; then copies with AddRef; ebp-based; retn 0x10

PutMemNewObj.description: Auto-creates object if slot empty; then calls PutMemObj; ebp-based; retn 0x10

SetMemNewObj.description: Tail-calls SetMemObj with inner 2 params; retn 0x10

GetMem1.description: Reads 1 byte from *src into *dst; returns 0 (S_OK); retn 0x8

PutMem1.description: Writes low byte of val to *dst; returns 0; retn 0x8

GetMemEvent.description: Copies IUnknown* from event source with AddRef; 4 params; retn 0x10

PutMemEvent.description: Tail-calls PutMemObj with inner 2 params; retn 0x10

SetMemEvent.description: Complex event Set: resolves object; calls helper; ebp-based; retn 0x10

__vbaLbound.description: Returns lLbound for the given 1-based dimension. Validates dimension >= 1 and <= cDims. retn 0x8.

__vbaLdZeroAry.description: Destroys existing array via SafeArrayDestroy; allocates new SAFEARRAY descriptor from template; copies bounds and element info; transfers pvData. retn 0x8.

__vbaLenVar.description: 0x6604c83a; retn 0x8; returns Len() of variant; coerces to string then calls __vbaLenBstr

__vbaLenVarB.description: LenB for variants; returns VT_I4 with byte count

__vbaLineInputVar.description: 0x660ea5f6; retn 0x8; reads a line into VARIANT (delegates to __vbaLineInputStr for BSTR subtype)

__vbaLsetFixstr.description: LSet for fixed strings; left-aligned with space padding

__vbaMidStmtVar.description: Mid$ for variants; doubles len/start and calls VarB

__vbaNameFile.description: VB 'Name' statement: converts BSTRs to ANSI; calls MoveFileA; raises VB file errors on failure

__vbaNextEachAry.description: 0x66111672; retn 0x10; iterates SAFEARRAY element by type; returns -1 if more or 0 if done

__vbaNextEachCollObj.description: wraps NextEachCollAd; QI result for target type

__vbaNextEachVar.description: 0x66111915; retn 0x14; dispatcher: if array type calls __vbaNextEachAry; else __vbaNextEachCollVar

__vbaObjAddref.description: Extracts IDispatch* from VT_DISPATCH variant (handles VT_BYREF); returns object ptr in EAX; retn 4. Despite name; does NOT call AddRef.

__vbaObjIs.description: QI both to IUnknown and compare identity; -1=same 0=different

__vbaObjSetAddref.description: AddRefs new without releasing old (flag=0); returns *ppobj

__vbaObjVar.description: NOTE: export at 0x6600b6ca shares address with __vbaPrintFile (file I/O function). Likely export table alias collision. Code at that address is a Print operation; not object extraction.

__vbaOnGoCheck.description: Validates On...GoTo/GoSub index: clamps to [0; 255] range; raises error 5 if negative

__vbaPrintFile.description: validates file mode; calls internal print formatter

__vbaPrintObj.description: export exists at ordinal 255; likely alias for __vbaPrintFile at 0x6600b6ca

__vbaPutFxStr3.description: 0x660f3573; retn 0xc; Put# for fixed-length string; 3 params

__vbaPutFxStr4.description: 0x660f35a9; retn 0x10; Put# for fixed-length string; 4 params

__vbaPutOwner4.description: 0x660f3556; retn 0x10; Put# with owner object; 4 params

__vbaR4Cy.description: fild qword; fdiv 10000.0f; retn 8; returns float in ST0

__vbaR4ErrVar.description: Like R4Var but with Error variant support; thunk -> shared dispatcher

__vbaR4ForNextCheck.description: 0x66112f1e; retn 0xc; For/Next loop check for Single; compares step sign; returns -1 (continue) or 0 (done)

__vbaR4Sgn.description: Compares with 0.0f; returns -1/0/1 in AX; retn 4

__vbaR4Str.description: BSTR→float via VarR4FromStr; returns on FPU st0

__vbaR4Var.description: Dispatches via vtype jump table; returns float in ST0; retn 4

__vbaR8Cy.description: Identical body to R4Cy but divides by 10000.0f returning double; retn 8

__vbaR8ErrVar.description: Like R8Var but with Error variant support; thunk -> shared dispatcher

__vbaR8FixI2.description: Calls __vbaFPFix; fistp word; bare retn; input in FPU ST0

__vbaR8FixI4.description: Calls __vbaFPFix; fistp dword; bare retn; input in FPU ST0

__vbaR8IntI2.description: Calls __vbaFPInt; fistp word; bare retn; input in FPU ST0

__vbaR8IntI4.description: Calls __vbaFPInt; fistp dword; bare retn; input in FPU ST0

__vbaR8Sgn.description: Compares with 0.0; returns -1/0/1 in AX; retn 8

__vbaRaiseEvent.description: 0x660e90b6; retn 0x10; walks event sink chain; invokes IDispatch::Invoke on each connected sink

__vbaRecAnsiToUni.description: Destroys pDst fields; then converts ANSI record fields to Unicode; returns pDst

__vbaRecAssign.description: Assigns UDT record: ecx=pRecInfo used by internal helper; returns pDst

__vbaRecDestruct.description: Destroys UDT record fields via CleanupPropertyEntries with flags=0; returns pRec

__vbaRecDestructAnsi.description: Destroys UDT with ANSI conversion flag=2 via CleanupPropertyEntries

__vbaRecUniToAnsi.description: Destroys pDst fields (ANSI flag=2); then converts Unicode record to ANSI (direction=1); returns pDst

__vbaRedim.description: variadic dim bounds (lbound;ubound pairs) follow numDims

__vbaRedimPreserve.description: same as Redim with preserve semantics

__vbaRedimPreserveVar.description: 0x660417cc; same entry as __vbaRedim; flag 0x20 bit determines preserve behavior

__vbaRedimVar.description: 0x660eda6e; var-args for bounds; delegates to internal redim helper 0x660ed604 with preserve=-1

__vbaRefVarAry.description: Returns a pointer to the SAFEARRAY* inside a VARIANT. If VT_BYREF; returns *(pVar+8); otherwise returns &pVar->data. Validates VT_ARRAY. retn 0x4.

__vbaRsetFixstr.description: RSet for fixed strings; right-aligned with space padding

__vbaStopExe.description: Displays 'Stop statement encountered' message then raises error 0x9c68; never returns normally

__vbaStrAryToAnsi.description: Wraps internal helper with direction=1 (to ANSI); converts SAFEARRAY of BSTRs to ANSI

__vbaStrAryToUnicode.description: Wraps internal helper with direction=0 (to Unicode); converts SAFEARRAY of ANSI strings to BSTRs

__vbaStrBool.description: Converts VB Boolean (int16) to BSTR via VariantChangeType(VT_BOOL->VT_BSTR)

__vbaStrCmp.description: binary compare wrapper; calls __vbaStrComp(0 bstr1 bstr2)

__vbaStrCy.description: Converts Currency (8-byte CY) to BSTR via VarBstrFromCy

BASIC_CLASS_QueryInterface.description: Delegates to inner object at pThis+0x8 via vtable[0] (QI); retn 0xc

BASIC_CLASS_AddRef.description: Delegates to inner object at pThis+0x8 via vtable[1] (AddRef)

BASIC_CLASS_Release.description: Delegates to inner object at pThis+0x8 via vtable[2] (Release)

BASIC_CLASS_GetIDsOfNames.description: Compares riid to IID_NULL; resolves via EventSink_GetVtableBase; retn 0x18

BASIC_CLASS_Invoke.description: Full IDispatch::Invoke; validates riid=IID_NULL; calls IDispatchInvoke; fallback chains through pThis+0x18/+0x10; retn 0x24

__vbaStrDate.description: Converts DATE (double) to BSTR via VarBstrFromDate; respects calendar setting

__vbaStrFixstr.description: Allocates fixed-length BSTR via SysAllocStringLen; error 0xe (out of memory) on failure

__vbaStrLike.description: Case-sensitive Like comparison; passes mode=0 to internal __vbaLikeStr; returns bool as i32

BASIC_DISPINTERFACE_GetTICount.description: Trivially stores 1 into *pctinfo and returns S_OK; retn 0x8

BASIC_DISPINTERFACE_GetTypeInfo.description: Validates iTInfo==0; resolves via EventSink_GetVtableBase; retn 0x10

__vbaStrTextCmp.description: text compare wrapper; calls __vbaStrComp(1 bstr1 bstr2)

__vbaStrTextLike.description: Case-insensitive Like comparison; passes mode=1 to internal __vbaLikeStr; returns bool as i32

__vbaStrToAnsi.description: Frees old *ppAnsi; converts Unicode BSTR to ANSI char*; returns ppAnsi content

__vbaStrToUnicode.description: Frees old *ppBstr via SysFreeString; converts ANSI to Unicode BSTR; returns new BSTR

__vbaStrUI1.description: Converts Byte to BSTR via VarBstrFromI2 (zero-extends to i16 first)

__vbaStrVarCopy.description: Extracts BSTR from VARIANT; if vt!=VT_BSTR; coerces via VariantChangeType; duplicates via SysAllocStringByteLen

Zombie_QueryInterface.description: Delegates QI to inner obj at pThis+0x8; validates ppvObj non-null; retn 0xc

__vbaStrVarMove.description: extracts BSTR from VT_BSTR variant (moves ownership); retn 4

__vbaStrVarVal.description: extracts or converts variant to BSTR; retn 8

EVENT_SINK2_AddRef.description: Resolves sink base via 0x6601756d; delegates to base vtable[1] (AddRef); retn 0x4

EVENT_SINK2_Release.description: Resolves sink base via 0x6601756d; delegates to base vtable[2] (Release); retn 0x4

__vbaUI1ErrVar.description: Like UI1Var but with Error variant support; thunk -> shared dispatcher

__vbaUI1Var.description: Dispatches via vtype jump table; range checks 0-255; thunk -> shared dispatcher

__vbaUdtVar.description: extracts UDT record data from VT_RECORD variant

__vbaVarCmpLt.description: writes VT_BOOL result variant; handles NULL→VT_NULL

__vbaVarCmpNe.description: writes VT_BOOL result variant; handles NULL→VT_NULL

__vbaVarDateVar.description: coerces src to VT_DATE into dest VARIANT

__vbaVarErrI4.description: creates VT_ERROR (vt=0xA); errcode OR'd with 0x800a0000; validates 0..0xffff; retn 8

__vbaVarIndexLoadRef.description: bare retn; frees presult if non-empty first

__vbaVarIndexLoadRefLock.description: bare retn; frees presult if non-empty; locks array data

__vbaVarIndexStore.description: bare retn; push flags=4; store value at index

__vbaVarIndexStoreObj.description: bare retn; push flags=8; Set store at index

__vbaVarLikeVar.description: binary Like; push flag=0; calls LikeHelper; writes result variant; retn 0xC

__vbaVarSetObj.description: frees dst; sets VT_DISPATCH(9); ObjSet flag=1 (release old)

__vbaVarSetObjAddref.description: frees dst; sets VT_DISPATCH(9); ObjSet flag=0 (no release)
